'''Jophil''' is a [[Malkier]]i standard bearer.

== Appearance ==
He is bald.

== Activities ==
He serves as [[Lan Mandragoran]]'s standard bearer at [[Tarwin's Gap]].{{ref/book|14|6}}
== Trivia ==
* Jophil is named for Joel Philips, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
